SAY: I'm happy to share vegetarian staples through Splitwise, and I propose weekend-only gatherings under 10 with notice by Thursday and common-area noise winding down by 11:30pm.

PFR:[groc:Share vegetarian staples (rice, lentils, oil) logged on Splitwise, own food separate, usp:Split equally, dep:Up to 1 month's rent]
FLX:[gwk:Weekly weekend gatherings under 10, notice by Thursday, common areas wind down by 11:30pm|if you're okay with my friends and me moving to my room or going out after that]
FLX:[cln:Rotating chore chart with a weekly check-in|if we write a short checklist of what "tidy" means for the kitchen and bathroom]
